_comment: Persona Transfer (Persona Replacement, modo transferencia - spec 'PERSONA REPLACEMENT - INTEGRACAO FOTOGRAFICA', 2026-10-06): a Luna INTEIRA gerada na pose da pessoa da foto, sem face swap. Roupa, acessorios e cenario sao os pixels da foto. Modelo/LoRA lidos da receita travada (so leitura).

transfer.prompt: lunavox, a woman, {description}, natural skin with pores, natural minimal makeup, same lighting as the photo, realistic unretouched photo

face_refinement.prompt: lunavox, a woman, natural face, natural minimal makeup, natural skin texture, realistic photo

integration.prompt: natural skin texture matching the photo, same lighting and shadows, seamless, realistic unretouched photo
